checkedAlternates.risk: The Runway Holding Position Sign has the word Runway in it.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Holding position signs and markings sit on the taxiway to prevent aircraft from entering an active runway (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: PAPI lights sit beside the airfield pavement.
checkedAlternates.resolution: PAPI lights provide vertical glide-slope guidance to landing aircraft aligned with the runway (group-4), not taxiway edge guidance (group-3).
